zh.title: 瑞安航空下修客運目標並示警同業冬季燃油危機
zh.summary: 瑞安航空下修年度客運目標並警告部分同業恐難撐過冬季燃油危機
body: 瑞安航空（Ryanair）於2026年9月2日宣布，將其2027財年客運目標下調至2.14億人次，低於先前預測的2.16億人次，以減少在通常虧損的冬季期間對燃油成本的曝險。
該公司表示，其已對截至2027年3月的燃油需求約80%進行避險，鎖定價格約每桶67美元；目前市場燃油價格約為每桶140美元，超過其鎖定價格的兩倍。
瑞安航空預測，避險比例較低的競爭同業，若油價在2027年仍居高不下，「可能難以維持運能，甚至可能無法撐過這個冬季」。
瑞安航空亦估計，相關調整將使冬季虧損減少約7000萬至1億歐元，並警告若油價持續偏高，短程票價可能上漲。

en.title: Ryanair cuts passenger target and warns rivals may not survive winter fuel crisis
en.summary: Ryanair cuts fiscal 2027 target; warns less-hedged rivals may not survive winter fuel prices
body: Irish low-cost carrier Ryanair said on September 2, 2026, that it now expects to carry 214 million passengers in its fiscal 2027 year, down from an earlier forecast of 216 million, as it trims exposure to high fuel costs during the winter season.
The airline has hedged about 80% of its fuel through March 2027 at roughly $67 per barrel, while jet fuel currently trades around $140 per barrel, according to Ryanair.
Ryanair warned that competitors with less protection "could struggle to maintain capacity or even survive this coming winter season" if high oil prices persist into 2027.
The carrier estimates the move will cut its winter losses by between EUR70 million and EUR100 million and said short-haul fares could rise if oil prices remain high into summer 2027.

zh.title: 空中巴士與全日空合作在葡萄牙培訓19名新飛行員
zh.summary: 空中巴士與全日空簽訂葡萄牙飛行訓練協議，19名學員將於今年開課
body: 空中巴士與全日空於2026年9月2日共同宣佈，首批19名無飛行經驗學員將在今年稍晚開始接受從零開始的飛行員訓練。
協議在亞太航空訓練峰會（APATS）敲定，訓練地點設於葡萄牙龐特德索爾的Sevenair Academy，學員將完成全部飛行訓練階段並取得執照。
空中巴士將為全日空集團及其合作夥伴航空公司提供統一的ab‑initio課程，並依據空中巴士全球服務預測，未來20年全球需求達633,000名新飛行員，亞太區佔104,000名。

en.title: Airbus and All Nippon Airways agree to train 19 rookie pilots in Portugal
en.summary: Airbus, All Nippon Airways sign Portugal pilot training deal for 19 cadets
body: On 2 September 2026 Airbus and All Nippon Airways jointly announced that the first 19 cadets with no prior flight experience will begin training later this year.

The agreement was finalised at the Asia Pacific Aviation Training Summit (APATS) and the training will take place at Sevenair Academy in Ponte de Sor, Portugal, covering every stage up to licence issuance.

Airbus will deliver a unified ab‑initio programme for the ANA Group and partner airlines; Airbus’s Global Services Forecast projects a need for 633,000 new pilots worldwide over the next 20 years, 104,000 in Asia‑Pacific.

zh.title: 波音執行長奥特伯格將於9月16日出席摩根士丹利拉古納會議
zh.summary: 波音執行長9月16日出席摩根士丹利會議；網路直播將於投資者網站提供
body: 波音於 2026 年 9 月 2 日透過 PRNewswire 發布新聞稿，宣佈執行長 Kelly Ortberg 將於 9 月 16 日上午 11 時 30 分（太平洋時間）在摩根士丹利拉古納會議發言。
新聞稿指出，會議的網路直播及後續逐字稿將可在波音投資者關係網站的「活動與簡報」頁面觀看，並提醒與會者提前驗證連線。
聲明並提供投資者關係信箱 BoeingInvestorRelations@boeing.com 及媒體聯絡信箱 media@boeing.com，供外界查詢。
波音亦建議與會者提前測試直播連結，以確保會議期間順暢收看。

en.title: Boeing CEO Kelly Ortberg to Speak at Morgan Stanley Laguna Conference on September 16
en.summary: Boeing CEO Kelly Ortberg to speak at Morgan Stanley Laguna Conference Sept 16; webcast on investor site
body: Boeing issued a press release on September 2, 2026 via PRNewswire from Arlington, Virginia, announcing that Chief Executive Officer Kelly Ortberg will speak at the Morgan Stanley Laguna Conference on September 16 at 11:30 a.m. Pacific Time.

The release states that a live webcast and a subsequent transcript will be available on the Events and Presentations section of Boeing’s investor relations website, and it advises participants to verify webcast access before the event.
Contact information is provided for investor relations at BoeingInvestorRelations@boeing.com and for media relations at media@boeing.com.
The company also encourages attendees to test the webcast link ahead of the conference to ensure uninterrupted viewing.
